decisions.reason: The modular plant concept has a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros a year and fits the firm's announced modular direction, so the sunk investment and public commitment favour persistence.
The mobile slow-speed shredder is close to the core offer and has its own page, but the new 2024 slow-speed shredder line could absorb it, which slightly raises the chance it is consolidated away.

As the multi-model flagship central to the firm's modular, cleaner-technology direction, it carries the highest visible commitment, and any weak results would be attributed to temporary market ramp-up.
